# 陳亮醫師 Liang Chen, MD

> Personal website of Liang Chen, MD (陳亮; also known as Lawrence Chen), a postgraduate year (PGY) physician at Taipei Tzu Chi Hospital, Buddhist Tzu Chi Medical Foundation, Taiwan. Graduate of Tzu Chi University School of Medicine. Interests: physical medicine and rehabilitation (PM&R), pain medicine, sports medicine and evidence-based medicine. The site is bilingual: Traditional Chinese at `/`, English at `/en/`.

陳亮醫師是台北慈濟醫院的 PGY 醫師，慈濟大學醫學系畢業，關注復健醫學、疼痛醫學、運動醫學與實證醫學。本站文章為個人學習紀錄，不提供個別醫療諮詢。

## Selected work

- Chen L, Hou WH, Riera R, Su CW, Horng YS. Transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) for chronic neck pain (Protocol). Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 2026, Issue 8. CD016383. https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD016383 (first author)
- Visiting observer, July 2026: Johns Hopkins Hospital (pain medicine), Johns Hopkins Bayview (PM&R), Massachusetts General Hospital and Mass General Brigham sports medicine
